architecture.thesis: Buzz 是一个 self-hostable Nostr-based team workspace，架构中心是 buzz-relay 作为 single source of truth——所有 read/write 流经它。这个决策是 multi-tenant 隔离 + hash-chain audit 单写入点 + channel-membership 访问控制统一执行的必要条件。Nostr 协议被保留是因为其签名事件模型和客户端兼容性，而非 P2P 特性。Wire 协议是 Nostr NIP-01：所有 action（消息/reaction/workflow step/git event/voice event）是签名事件，kind 整数是唯一分发开关，新功能=新 kind=零破坏。多 pod 横向扩展通过 Redis pub/sub + 共享 Postgres 实现，buzz-relay-mesh（iroh QUIC）承载 session traffic（huddle/tunnel）between pods。子系统按 layered architecture 组织：buzz-core(base, 零 I/O) → buzz-db/buzz-auth(mid) → buzz-pubsub(依赖 auth)/buzz-workflow(依赖 db)；buzz-search/buzz-audit 通过直接 sqlx + 自有 pool 隔离。buzz-relay 是唯一 composition root。

invariants.statement: 单逻辑 relay per community——所有 read/write 流经 buzz-relay，子系统相互不直接调用，跨子系统协调仅通过 relay。

Row-zero host binding——req.community = resolve_host(connection.host) 在任何 handler 观察数据前完成，fail-closed，无 default/fallback community。Client-supplied tag 可 narrow authority 但不能 override host-derived community。
SQL-level community_id 隔离——buzz-db 所有 query 携带 WHERE community_id，覆盖 events/channels/dms/feed/users/reactions/threads/workflows/git_repos/api_tokens/moderation/push/usage 全部数据访问路径。
Layered crate dependency——buzz-core(零 I/O) 是 base，subsystem 不反向引用，buzz-relay 是唯一依赖所有 subsystem 的 composition root。无循环依赖。buzz-search/buzz-audit 通过直接 sqlx 而非 buzz-db 实现隔离。
Nostr kind 整数是唯一分发开关——新功能通过新增 kind 实现，ALL_KINDS 数组 + #[test] no_duplicate_kind_values 编译期强制无 collision。40000-49999 自定义 range 按功能域子划分。
Event pipeline 12 步顺序执行——AUTH→PUBKEY MATCH→KIND_AUTH REJECT→EPHEMERAL ROUTE→VERIFY→MEMBERSHIP→DB INSERT→REDIS PUBLISH→FAN-OUT→SEARCH INDEX→AUDIT LOG→WORKFLOW TRIGGER。Step 10-12 fire-and-forget。
Global subscriptions excluded from channel-scoped events——这是 deliberate security boundary，只有 scoped to accessible channel_id 的 subscription 接收 channel-scoped events。

boundaries.statement: Tenant boundary = URL host——communities sharing infrastructure cannot see each other (events, profiles, DMs, search results, audit chains, error strings)。URL 是 authoritative，unknown host fail-closed。
Subsystem boundary = Cargo dependency graph——buzz-search/buzz-audit 不依赖 buzz-db（直接 sqlx），buzz-pubsub 依赖 buzz-auth，buzz-workflow 依赖 buzz-db。buzz-relay 依赖所有。

Protocol boundary = Nostr kind integer——standard NIP kinds (0-9999) + replaceable (10000-19999) + ephemeral (20000-29999, not stored/audited) + parameterized replaceable (30000-39999) + Buzz custom (40000-49999)。
Auth boundary = NIP-42 (WebSocket signed challenge) / NIP-98 (HTTP Schnorr-signed kind:27235)。Auth 是 binary（authenticated or not），channel membership gates content visibility。

Ephemeral boundary = kind 20000-29999 bypass DB storage/audit/search。Presence (20001) 走 Redis SET EX + local fan-out；其他 ephemeral 走 membership check + local fan-out。Multi-node presence fan-out 是 future work。

extension_points.statement: 新功能 = 新 Nostr kind——在 buzz-core/src/kind.rs 添加 pub const + 更新 ALL_KINDS + CI duplicate test。客户端通过 'unknown kind 忽略' 语义保证向后兼容。
Workflow engine 通过监听 event kind 触发 YAML-as-code automation——message/reaction/schedule/webhook triggers。但 workflow execution kinds (46001-46012) 被 excluded 防止循环。
Agent surface = MCP + buzz-cli——agents 通过 MCP tools 或 buzz-cli（JSON in/out）访问 relay 全部 feature surface。Agent identity = NIP-98 + bot role。
Git hosting = NIP-34 events——Smart HTTP transport + pre-receive hook + HMAC policy callback。NIP-34 kinds 定义完整（PATCH/PR/ISSUE/STATUS/REPO_ANNOUNCEMENT）但仅 REPO_ANNOUNCEMENT 被 active 处理。

patterns.statement: Layered crate architecture——buzz-core(零 I/O 共享) → subsystems(各自领域) → buzz-relay(composition root)。subsystem 通过 Cargo 依赖图 compile-time 强制无循环依赖。
Single tokio runtime + spawn_blocking——所有 I/O 在 main tokio runtime，阻塞操作 spawn_blocking 隔离。无 per-route concurrency limit，依赖 connection semaphore + SLOW_CLIENT_GRACE_LIMIT。
Redis as fence——多 pod 横向扩展通过 Redis pub/sub (event fan-out + cache invalidation + connection control) + Redis fenced generation (mesh session ownership)。Redis 是 arbiter，mesh membership 是 hint。

Fire-and-forget side effects——event pipeline step 10-12 (search index/audit log/workflow trigger) spawn independent async tasks，失败不影响 event submission。bounded worker queue (capacity 1000) for search indexing。
Leader election for expensive ticks——usage metrics poller 使用 DB-based advisory lock (USAGE_METRICS_LOCK_KEY) 选主，只有 leader 跑 DB-derived snapshot，所有 pod 跑 in-memory gauges。
Hash-chain audit log——buzz-audit 维护 tamper-evident log，依赖单写入点（relay）保证链完整性。
Conformance probe as deployment gate——git object-store A3 conditional-write axiom 在启动时 probe，失败 fatal。这是 formal-method-inspired engineering practice。

threading_model.blocking_isolation: spawn_blocking for verify_event (Schnorr sig + ID hash) and other blocking I/O
concurrency_control: 1MB body limit on git policy endpoint
threading_model.risk: voice frame 与 event pipeline 共享 worker threads，存在 head-of-line blocking 风险。Git large clone 可能耗尽 connection。无 per-route concurrency limit。

startup_flow: spawn Redis subscribers (fan-out + cache invalidation + conn control)
AuthService + SearchService (own PgPool, prefers read replica) init
Git conformance probe (A3 gate, fatal on fail)
Push matcher + delivery worker spawn (if push gateway configured)
Usage metrics poller spawn (300s interval, jittered)
serve() — bind TCP + optional UDS + health port

request_flow.websocket_event: AUTH CHECK → PUBKEY MATCH → KIND_AUTH REJECT → EPHEMERAL ROUTE → VERIFY(spawn_blocking) → MEMBERSHIP → DB INSERT(ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) → REDIS PUBLISH(if channel-scoped) → FAN-OUT(excludes global subs for channel events) → SEARCH INDEX(bounded queue, fire-and-forget) → AUDIT LOG(async, fire-and-forget) → WORKFLOW TRIGGER(async, excludes own kinds)
request_flow.websocket_req: Subscription filter match against SubscriptionRegistry DashMap (channel_id, kind) → conns。Fan-out via conn_manager.send_to。Multi-node via Redis pub/sub subscriber loop。
request_flow.git_smart_http: Smart HTTP transport (info/refs, upload-pack, receive-pack) → pre-receive hook → /internal/git/policy (localhost only, HMAC auth) → manifest_event publish

lifecycle.connection: Semaphore Acquire → NIP-42 Challenge → Auth(Pending→Authenticated) → recv_loop + send_loop + heartbeat_loop(30s ping, 3 missed pong → disconnect) → Cleanup(cancel → remove subs → deregister → drop permit)
lifecycle.graceful_shutdown: SIGTERM → shutting_down=true → readiness 503 → 5s grace → drain_all(1012 close frame to all WS) → 30s hard timeout → force exit。OTEL spans flush。Audit drain(5s)。
lifecycle.ephemeral_channel_reaper: 60s loop → reap_expired_ephemeral_channels → per-row tenant (channel carries own community_id) → emit_system_message + emit_group_discovery_events + evict_all_channel_subscriptions

mechanisms: mesh datagram drop-on-full (never blocks on old audio)
backpressure.gap: 无 per-route concurrency limit——voice + event + git 共享 worker pool，head-of-line blocking 风险

mechanisms: Redis fence generation 仲裁 mesh session ownership
DB advisory lock 选主 usage metrics leader
failure_isolation.gap: 单 tokio runtime——一个 panic 的 task 可能影响整个 process。无 supervisor 重启策略。

design_decisions.decision: 选择单逻辑 relay 作为 single source of truth 而非 Nostr 多 relay P2P
design_decisions.context: Nostr 原生是多 relay P2P gossip。Buzz 需要 multi-tenant 隔离 + audit 完整性 + access control。
alternatives: 多 relay P2P gossip（标准 Nostr）
多 relay + 客户端聚合
design_decisions.tradeoffs: 放弃 P2P 去中心化特性换取：(+) multi-tenant 隔离的中央权威边界；(+) hash-chain audit 单写入点；(+) channel-membership 统一执行；(+) 强一致性 Postgres。(-) 单点故障风险（mitigated by 多 pod 横向扩展）；(-) 运营成本（operator 需部署 relay）。

design_decisions.decision: Multi-tenant 通过 URL host binding + SQL community_id WHERE 实现
design_decisions.context: 一个 relay 部署可托管多 community，共享 Postgres/Redis/S3。
alternatives: schema-level 隔离（每 community 独立 schema）
design_decisions.tradeoffs: 选择 row-level community_id WHERE：(+) 共享池资源利用率高；(+) 新 community 仅 DB write + DNS route；(+) 已有 TLA+/Tamarin 形式化验证。(-) SQL 漏写 community_id = 跨租户泄露（mitigated by code review + buzz-conformance 测试）；(-) 形式化验证在协议层非 SQL 层（gap）。

design_decisions.decision: Subsystem isolation 通过 Cargo 依赖图 + layered architecture
design_decisions.context: 需要避免子系统耦合导致循环依赖和测试困难。
design_decisions.tradeoffs: Layered crate：(+) Cargo 编译期强制无循环；(+) buzz-search/buzz-audit 直接 sqlx 避免污染 db abstraction；(+) buzz-relay 唯一 composition root，测试清晰。(-) buzz-pubsub 依赖 buzz-auth、buzz-workflow 依赖 buzz-db——非严格 isolation 而是 layered；(-) 跨 subsystem 共享类型（如 AuthContext）需通过 buzz-core 或上游依赖。

design_decisions.decision: 单 tokio runtime 承载所有工作负载（WS + HTTP + git + voice + mesh + cron）
design_decisions.context: Rust monolith，需要简化部署和共享状态。
design_decisions.tradeoffs: 单 runtime：(+) 共享 AppState 简单；(+) 部署简单（单 binary）；(+) 无 IPC 开销。(-) voice frame 与 event pipeline 共享 worker threads——head-of-line blocking 风险；(-) 无 per-route concurrency limit；(-) 单 panic 影响 entire process。Mitigation: connection semaphore + SLOW_CLIENT_GRACE_LIMIT + mesh datagram drop-on-full。这是 production SLO 的主要 risk。

design_decisions.decision: Git hosting 实现完整 Smart HTTP + NIP-34 事件存储，但 branch-as-channel 不实现
design_decisions.context: VISION 描述 branch as room（CI/review/merge in channel），README 标 git events ✅。
alternatives: 声明为 planned 不实现
design_decisions.tradeoffs: 当前选择（仅事件存储）：(+) NIP-34 事件可被客户端消费；(+) Smart HTTP 完整。(-) VISION 与实现 gap——branch-as-room 是 aspirational；(-) README '✅ git events works today' 误导（仅指事件接收）。这是 product positioning 的 honest gap。

design_decisions.decision: Buzz Mesh AI compute 作为 experimental feature（dev-dependency，非 production）
design_decisions.context: VISION_MESH 描述 P2P compute commons。
design_decisions.tradeoffs: experimental：(+) 探索性功能不阻塞 production；(+) mesh-llm 外部项目独立演进。(-) README 'Buzz Mesh ✅' 误导——✅ 指 relay-mesh session transport（huddle/tunnel），非 AI compute；(-) inference result verification 不存在——信任模型基于 relay membership。aspirational feature 应明确标注。

design_decisions.decision: Kind registry 通过 centralized const + ALL_KINDS + CI duplicate test 强制
design_decisions.context: Nostr kind 整数是有限资源，需要避免 collision。
design_decisions.tradeoffs: centralized const：(+) 编译期强制无重复；(+) 性能（const 编译期内联）；(+) 简单。(-) 无 runtime 扩展（需 recompile）；(-) 子 range 划分无 lint 强制，依赖 code review；(-) 无 CONTRIBUTING governance 章节文档化 range 分配规则。Trade-off 可接受——duplicate test 防最严重 collision，40000-49999 range 足够大。

design_decisions.decision: Multi-pod 横向扩展通过 Redis pub/sub + 共享 Postgres + buzz-relay-mesh（iroh QUIC for session traffic）
design_decisions.context: 单 relay 进程不足以承载 10K humans + 50K agents + 600K events/day。
design_decisions.tradeoffs: Redis + mesh：(+) Redis 已用于 presence/typing/cache，复用；(+) mesh (iroh QUIC) 提供低延迟 session transport 给 huddle；(+) Redis fenced generation 仲裁 session ownership。(-) Redis 是单点（需 Redis Cluster/Sentinel）；(-) 多 pod presence fan-out 是 future work（当前 local-only）；(-) local-echo dedup via AppState.local_event_ids 增加复杂度。

design_decisions.decision: Formal verification (TLA+/Tamarin) 用于 multi-tenant isolation 协议层 + mutation-tested
design_decisions.context: 多租户隔离是 production-critical，需要最强保证。
design_decisions.tradeoffs: TLA+/Tamarin 协议层：(+) host→community 映射的形式化保证；(+) mutation-tested 验证 spec 质量；(+) redteam_attack2 测试模块验证 empty host fence。(-) gap：SQL community_id 覆盖层是 conventional，非形式化验证——需人工 review + buzz-conformance 测试；(-) 形式化 spec 维护成本高。

design_decisions.decision: Workflow approval gates infrastructure exists (DB/API/MCP/UI) but executor doesn't persist/resume (WF-08)
design_decisions.context: YAML workflow engine + approval gates 是关键 feature。
alternatives: 完整 durable state machine（persist + resume）
design_decisions.tradeoffs: infrastructure-first：(+) schema/REST/MCP/UI 已就位，executor 接线即可激活；(+) 渐进式交付。(-) WF-08 是已知 gap——request_approval step 标记 Failed；(-) production workflow 不能跨 restart 持久化。这是 shipping gap，非设计缺陷。

timeline.phase: Huddles (WebSocket Opus voice relay + lifecycle events)
timeline.evidence: VISION.md Status section, audio/ module in code

timeline.phase: Buzz Mesh session transport (iroh QUIC inter-relay)
Buzz Mesh AI compute (mesh-llm shared GPU)

timeline.status: ❌ aspirational (NIP-34 kinds defined, no auto-creation logic)

timeline.phase: Push notifications + culture features + developer portal

motivations: 统一 Nostr 协议承载所有 surface（chat/forum/DM/workflow/git/voice）——一个事件 log + 一个 search index + 一个 identity 模型
Humans 和 agents 是 first-class equals——同 keypair + 同 audit trail + 同 channel membership
Self-hostable + multi-tenant 兼容——单社区部署 = 多社区部署的 N=1 退化
Formal verification 用于 production-critical isolation 保证

architectural_changes.change: buzz-relay-mesh 引入 iroh QUIC 作为 inter-relay session transport
architectural_changes.motivation: 多 pod 横向扩展时，huddle voice frames 和 reliable stream tunnels 需要低延迟 P2P transport，Postgres/Redis 不适合

architectural_changes.change: TenantContext row-zero binding 重构——empty host fence 修复（redteam_attack2）
architectural_changes.motivation: 安全 audit 发现 empty/whitespace host 即使 DB 有空 host 行也应 fail closed

architectural_changes.change: NIP-43 relay membership enforcement——stable signing key required
architectural_changes.motivation: relay 签名的事件（如 membership snapshots）需跨 restart 可验证，ephemeral key 不可接受

architectural_changes.change: Git conformance probe (A3 gate) 作为部署 gate
architectural_changes.motivation: git-on-object-storage 需要 S3/MinIO 后端满足 linearizable conditional-write axiom，启动时 probe 防止运行时才发现 backend 不合规

extensibility.reasoning: Nostr kind 整数作为统一扩展点优秀（新功能=新 kind=零破坏）。Subsystem layered architecture 清晰。但子系统间有隐性耦合（pubsub→auth, workflow→db），且 branch-as-channel 扩展未实现显示 VISION 与实现 gap。

maintainability.reasoning: 27 个 focused crate + Cargo workspace + 编译期依赖检查 + 集中化 kind registry + TLA+/Tamarin spec + redteam 测试模块。但单 tokio runtime + 12 步 event pipeline + 多个 cron 后台任务增加认知复杂度。

performance.reasoning: Postgres 分区 + Redis pub/sub + bounded queue + leader election 优秀。但单 tokio runtime 共享所有 workload 是 SLO 风险——voice + event + git 并发时 head-of-line blocking。无 per-route concurrency limit。600K events/day + 10K humans + 50K agents 目标需验证。

testability.reasoning: HostResolver trait 使 tenant binding 可无 DB 测试。redteam_attack2 测试模块验证安全 fence。buzz-conformance crate 提供 relay conformance 工具。kind.rs 单元测试验证 duplicate + range。但 integration test 需 Postgres + Redis，无完整 e2e harness 在仓库中可见。

observability.reasoning: JSON structured logs + OpenTelemetry OTLP + Prometheus metrics + per-community gauges + pool metrics + leader election metrics + fence observability + usage metrics（DB-derived + in-memory）。 Datadog-compatible。EmissionScope 控制成本。这是 production-grade observability。

security.reasoning: Row-zero host binding + fail-closed + TLA+/Tamarin 形式化验证 + redteam 测试 + hash-chain audit + NIP-42/NIP-98 签名 auth + localhost-only policy endpoint + HMAC。Gap：SQL community_id 是 conventional 非 enforced；E2E encryption 是 future；inference result verification 不存在（mesh）。

evolution.reasoning: 清晰的 Status 表区分 shipped/wired/planned。NIP-43 membership 重构 + empty host fence 修复显示安全驱动演进。但 VISION 与实现 gap（branch-as-channel, Buzz Mesh AI compute）需更明确标注，README '✅' 标注有误导风险。

risks.risk: 单 tokio runtime head-of-line blocking——voice frame + event pipeline + git clone 共享 worker threads
risks.evidence: main.rs #[tokio::main] + audio/handler.rs 标准 WS handler
risks.mitigation: connection semaphore + SLOW_CLIENT_GRACE_LIMIT + mesh datagram drop-on-full。但无 per-route concurrency limit。

risks.risk: SQL community_id 漏写导致跨租户数据泄露——形式化验证在协议层，SQL 层 conventional
risks.evidence: TLA+/Tamarin 验证 host→community 映射，buzz-db 1264 次 community_id 是 conventional 覆盖
risks.mitigation: code review + buzz-conformance 测试。但无 macro/lint 强制每条 SQL 携带 community_id。

risks.risk: Buzz Mesh AI compute 信任模型——无 inference result verification，恶意 member 可返回错误输出
risks.evidence: mesh-llm dev-dependency + 无 verify 机制 grep 结果
risks.mitigation: experimental feature，production 不默认包含。但若启用需补充 verification。

risks.risk: README/VISION 与实现 gap 误导用户——'Buzz Mesh ✅' 指 session transport 非 AI compute；'git events ✅' 指存储非 branch-as-room
risks.mitigation: 需在 README 明确区分 'relay-mesh session transport' vs 'mesh-llm AI compute'，'NIP-34 event storage' vs 'branch-as-room workflow'。

risks.risk: Workflow approval gates (WF-08)——executor 不 persist/resume approval token，request_approval step 标记 Failed
risks.mitigation: infrastructure 已就位（DB/API/MCP/UI），executor 接线即可激活。但当前 production workflow 跨 restart 不持久化。

risks.risk: Multi-node presence fan-out 缺失——presence (kind 20001) 仅 local fan-out，多 pod 部署时跨 pod presence 不可见
risks.mitigation: documented as future work。single-pod 部署不受影响。

risks.risk: 单 tokio process panic 影响整个 relay——无 supervisor 重启策略
risks.mitigation: K8s deployment 可配置 restartPolicy + readiness/liveness probe + graceful drain(30s)。但单 task panic 不隔离。
